label: D1 after a reward, when the agent leans moderately toward a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2) and only when the reward input is 1 (the previous trial was rewarded). Almost all activations come right before the agent picks a2: 99.9% of mass has upcoming action == 2, and the previous choice is almost never a1 (it is a2, or the window starts). The policy logit at D1 sits in a moderate a2-preferring band (choice in [-4.44, -1.52)), which covers 100% of the mass; it never fires when the a2 preference is strong (choice < -4.44) or at high value (> 7.73). The simple observable version (D1 & rewarded & upcoming a2 & previous choice not a1) gets dev F1 0.64 with recall 0.999. The recorded choice-band version gets dev F1 0.70 (P 0.54, R 0.999). Precision stays around 0.5: on many rewarded a2 D1 steps the unit stays below threshold, and the only partial correlate is the model value band (7.13 to 7.73). Activation tends to build over runs of rewarded a2 trials and is mostly absent in the last ~15 trials of an episode. Upcoming action is the own choice of the agent, so no unobservable future variable is used. Best read as a graded unit for a rewarded, moderately confident a2 stay, with only its extreme end above threshold.
